items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Little dad, he used to come over with Sam Argan, come over with this band or that band. Well, they all knew me through capital. And they'd come over. Where's Little Henry? The one who played banjo, I want to cut his head. They would be teasing me, you know, but they would take me and teach me.

ctx.x: He took his time, and he would sit down with me and teach me this part, and teach me that part. Little dad, they had a, you remember Little Daddy? Yes.
